INSERT INTO index_minute_quote ( index_code, index_name, trade_date, quote_time, current_price, previous_close_price, data_source, collected_at ) VALUES
( #{quote.indexCode}, #{quote.indexName}, #{quote.tradeDate}, #{quote.quoteTime}, #{quote.currentPrice}, #{quote.previousClosePrice}, #{quote.dataSource}, #{quote.collectedAt} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE index_name = VALUES(index_name), trade_date = VALUES(trade_date), current_price = VALUES(current_price), previous_close_price = VALUES(previous_close_price), data_source = VALUES(data_source), collected_at = VALUES(collected_at), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, index_code, index_name, trade_date, quote_time, current_price, previous_close_price, data_source, collected_at, created_at, updated_at FROM index_minute_quote WHERE index_code = #{indexCode} AND quote_time >= #{startTime} AND quote_time <= #{endTime} ORDER BY quote_time
